{{Quote|Then the Melida invaded his village. His cousin escaped and took him to Zehava.|Cerasi, recounting Nield's childhood to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="JA5p65" />}}
A '''village''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] was the home of the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] child [[Nield]] and [[Nield's cousin|his cousin]]<ref name="JA5p65" /> in the 50s [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. In the late part of that [[Time/Legends|decade]],<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'', [[Nield]] is approximately the same age as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who is thirteen at the time. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''Defenders of the Dead'' in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], meaning that Nield was born in approximately [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]]. Nield fled the village after a [[Battle of Nield's village|particular battle]] which occurred between two others&mdash;the [[Unidentified battle (Micae's death)|first]] occurring when Nield was five, or approximately [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], and the [[Battle of Zehava (Nield's cousin's death)|second]] when he was eight, or approximately [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]]. The book also states that Nield had "a few peaceful years" between leaving his village and the battle in 49 BBY, so Nield must have departed his village sometime between [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] and approximately [[51 BBY/Legends|51 BBY]].</ref> the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] tribe, who were embroiled in a [[Melida/Daan Civil War|civil war]] with the Daan tribe, [[Battle of Nield's village|invaded]] the village, forcing Nield and his cousin to flee to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]].<ref name="JA5p65" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nield's village is briefly mentioned in the [[1999]] young readers book [[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead|''The Defenders of the Dead'']], the fifth entry in [[Jude Watson]]'s [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] young readers series, as Nield's friend [[Cerasi]] recounts the struggles of Nield's childhood to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
